title: Chapter 234: The Bandits Are Defeat
content:
Chapter 234: The Bandits Are Defeat

As for the bandits under his command, let them escape as many as they can.

However, his decision seemed wise, but in fact it was extremely stupid.

Seeing the bandits turning back and leaving, Gong Kai immediately ordered the archers to shoot quickly, because the bandits would soon be out of their attack range.

And Ayub, who rushed down the hill, had turned his horse's head and charged towards the position in front of Li Jianguo in advance.

The most critical thing was Li Jianguo.

He looked at the bandits rushing from the heights, and under the cover of arrow feathers, there were only more than 300 people left.

"Aim all the bronze spears at the leaders of the bandits."

"Yes."

Seeing the crossbow cart on the opposite side, Good adjusted the angle, his heart pounding, as if he sensed a hint of danger.

However, at this time, it was in the acceleration stage of the downhill charge, and it was difficult to make adjustments. At the same time, he also saw Ayub rushing from the side, and his soul was even more scared.

"My life is over!"

"Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!"

The bronze spears were shot out, each of which could cause 2,000 points of damage. Even with defense to reduce damage, the amount of damage was still terrifyingly high.

In just one round of attack, the six horse bandit leaders died on the spot.

Good was also pierced by three spears and fell off his horse.

Just as the remaining horse bandits were about to rush to the crossbow camp position, Ayub's golden fire cavalry also rushed into the horse bandits.

It was like a hot pot meeting cold oil!

It melted like snowflakes.

The powerful charge of the heavy cavalry directly knocked countless horse bandits away.

This time it was a plain charge, and the speed of the heavy cavalry was maximized.

The horse bandits suffered heavy casualties.

There were only dozens of horse bandits still on horseback.

"Surrender and no killing!"

"Surrender and no killing!"

...

The Red Flame Army shouted loudly, and the horse bandits standing there were a little at a loss for a while!

Seeing the bronze crossbow cart in front, loading spears again, and Ayub also jumped and turned his horse's head.

The remaining horse bandits collapsed!

"I surrender, I surrender..."

In this battle, the Red Flame Army won a great victory!

[You won the battle with Pegasus Village at a small cost. ]

[Wana Village Territory Reputation +200]

[Your Command Value +5]

[Your subordinates, ... Command Value +2]

[Your subordinates, ... Level Up...]

A series of system prompts sounded.

Wang Shuo was not surprised.

Wang Shuo rode from the hill to Gude and pulled out the spear from his body.

This strong man actually gritted his teeth and didn't make a single cry.

Although Wang Shuo had not experienced the pain of the spear piercing his body, he could imagine it.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but look at him again.

Wang Shuo ordered people to treat his injuries, and Gude did not refuse.

"Are you willing to submit to me?"

Good turned his head away stubbornly.

"You are a defeated general, don't even think about making me surrender."

Wang Shuo really wanted to be talented. After all, the other party was a senior general. The three strongest fighters in Wana Village could only tie with him at most. Wang Shuo really wanted to get his loyalty.

Seeing the other party's unconvinced look, Wang Shuo did not give up. He took him back first and talked about it later!

"Clean up the battlefield." Wang Shuo said to everyone.

The soldiers began to take prisoners and clean up the battlefield.

Soon, Zou Yuanjie came over and said to Wang Shuo: "Lord, in this battle, we lost 30 Black Mountain bandits and 40 shield soldiers. A total of 812 horse bandits were destroyed, including 340 prisoners and 600 horses were confiscated."
